source_policy: release 2026.11.12-figure-table-fallback: when text inside a figure or table cannot be typeset, only that figure or table keeps its exact source ink and the rest of the page is translated (no source-page fallback, no cross-page expansion from this cause); groups are proposed from layout and accepted only if every element passes an attribute-only validator; prompts, extraction and caches unchanged
excluded_classes: production uploads, outputs, progress, tasks, caches, logs and installer state
fonts, audit evidence, backups and Git metadata
tests, test requirements and release tooling (kept in the source repository)
validation: Local regression suite: 559 passed, 2 skipped (Python 3.13, constraints.txt, PyMuPDF 1.27.2.3), including 67 figure/table fallback tests with a seeded property test of the group guarantees; an offline, keyless reassembly of a real 9-page production job on the production host turned its four source-page fallbacks into four narrowed figures/tables with every other page unchanged; three review rounds by two independent reviewers.
